direction: Reference, record, refine — one letterform system
data_status: Illustrative normalized design values; not user records or exercise outcome evidence.

color_policy.strategy: Accent symbol plus a neutral continuous name; intentional, not mandatory for every placement.
color_policy.source: Existing Reprism app accent, foreground and background tokens; light-surface colors are adapted variants.

ink.reason: Connect the initial used as a standalone identifier with the existing product accent. Keep the anchor recognizable within the complete name.

record.reason: A tonal variation within the accent family distinguishes the inner curve gently. Its gap and geometry carry the relationship in monochrome.

type.reason: Use one neutral foreground to keep the full name readable and visually calm beside the accent symbol. Do not color individual letters separately.

review.target_status: Project-specific design review target, not a claim that all logos must meet WCAG text thresholds.
review.method: W3C relative luminance and (Lighter + 0.05) / (Darker + 0.05); nominal solid colors, not antialiased edge pixels.
checks: Consistent element roles across dark and light variants
Recognition in monochrome without hue-dependent meaning

color_policy.monochrome: Use one foreground for R, its trace, and eprism when a quiet signature or one-ink reproduction is preferable.
color_policy.boundary: Accent versus neutral is visual hierarchy, not an assertion that R has greater conceptual importance or that green proves scientific credibility.
